context.label: Smart doorbell camera that records the front door and shares clips to a phone app

links.label: Recording more of the street makes homeowners feel safer, but records people who never agreed to it.
links.action: Record only the doorstep by default; blur the street.

links.label: Police requests for footage can sweep in neighbours who had nothing to do with an incident.
links.action: Share footage only with a warrant, and tell everyone who appears in it.

links.label: “Suspicious person” alerts protect homes but single out people for being in public space.
links.action: Remove “suspicious person” labels from shared posts.

impacts.text: Sees who is at the door from anywhere
Clips stored on company servers could be leaked
Their comings and goings are logged for others in the home to see
Watched at every stop; clips sometimes posted online
Proof of delivery protects them from false claims
Their doorway and garden are in view of the camera
Can’t turn it off; the landlord sees when they come and go
Reported as “suspicious” for sitting or sleeping nearby

values.name: Privacy
values.definition: Moving through your own doorway and street without being recorded or watched by people you didn’t choose.
values.action: Add privacy zones that blur the street and neighbours’ property by default.

values.name: Safety
values.definition: Being, and feeling, protected from theft and intruders at home.
values.action: Alert on people at the door, not on everyone who walks past.

values.name: Dignity
values.definition: Being treated as a person, not a suspect, while doing your job or being in a public place.
values.action: Ban posting clips that mock or accuse people without evidence.

values.name: Trust
values.definition: Confidence that the footage is accurate and used fairly by everyone who can see it.
values.action: Publish a yearly report on how footage is shared with police.

values.name: Autonomy
values.definition: Deciding for yourself when you are recorded in the place where you live.
values.action: Let every household member and tenant pause recording while they’re home.

values.name: Informed consent
values.definition: Knowing you are being recorded, and having a real choice about it.
values.action: Make the camera and its recording light clearly visible from the street.

values.name: Fairness
values.definition: Not being singled out because of how you look or where you sleep.
values.action: Audit which people get reported as “suspicious”, and how often.
